blocks.text: The Melissa & Doug Seek & Find Sticker Pad – Animals brings interactive discovery to every page. Kids can hunt for hidden items across 14 beautifully illustrated scenes, from coral reefs to dino digs, matching over 400 color-coded stickers as they go. Once the stickers are placed, the fun continues—each scene can be colored with markers, pencils, or crayons to bring their creations to life. Designed for growing minds, this combination of sticker play and coloring promotes concentration, hand-eye coordination, and creative storytelling. Perforated pages make it easy to remove sticker sheets and completed art for display or sharing. Whether at home, in classrooms, or on trips, this activity pad keeps kids engaged with imaginative, screen-free fun. For even more exciting road trip activities for kids, look for the Melissa and Doug Water WOW!™ and Sticker WOW!™ sets that are sure to spark creativity, excitement & joy for kids 4 and up, who love arts & crafts and creating imaginative pretend play adventures For 35+ years, Melissa and Doug has crafted imaginative preschool toys and durable wooden toys built to nurture childhood wonder, with everything from a life-sized grocery store playset to a play kitchen playset and play food to serve plush toys & puppets, to costumes, arts & crafts, and road trip activities for kids. It’s the kind of kid-powered play that builds independence and confidence! This product is certified by the Forest Stewardship Council. FSC certification ensures that products come from responsibly managed forests that provide environmental, social, and economic benefits, and that forests are protected for future generations. Please note that FSC certification applies to new inventory only (FSC C156584)
